name: SV Number MCP Server
tagline: Phone numbers as MCP tools — order a number, read SMS codes, hand it back
description: SV Number MCP Server turns phone numbers into tools for AI agents. An agent can order a private number in the country a service expects (200+ countries, the widest coverage in the category), read the SMS verification code straight from the API, and hand the number back. It exposes nine tools over stdio — order_number, wait_for_code, finish_activation, totp_code, and more — with no SDK to learn. The API key is read from the environment, never leaves the process, and appears in no error message.
highlights: Nine MCP tools over stdio: order_number, wait_for_code, finish_activation, totp_code, and more
200+ countries covered — the widest coverage in the category
No SDK to learn; install with claude mcp add sv-number
API key stays in the environment and never leaks through tools or errors
curatorNote: A genuinely novel MCP use case: agents that need to verify an SMS code now have a tool for it. The design is careful too — the key never leaves the environment and TOTP is handled server-side.
